details.name: PricePeep
details.who: All Firefox users who have Pricepeed below 2.1.0.20 installed.
details.why: Versions older than 2.1.0.20 of the PricePeep add-on were silently side-installed with other software, injecting advertisements in Firefox. Versions 2.1.0.20 and above don't have the install problems are not blocked.
